checks.name: identity
checks.observation: Deep goblet squat is recognizable with one vertical dumbbell held near the chest and downward elbows inside the knees.

checks.name: style-consistency

checks.observation: Both hands visibly cup/wrap the upper end of the same dumbbell. Both complete shoes and heels appear planted, with coherent hip/knee/ankle paths and a natural forward torso lean. No extra or disconnected limb, floating weight or impossible bend observed. Independent source reviewer agrees.

checks.name: equipment-continuity
checks.observation: Exactly one gray dumbbell has a continuous vertical handle and two coherent hex ends. Both hands contact its upper end; no duplicate weight or disconnected grip observed.

checks.name: decoded-alpha
checks.observation: Viewed actual source/export light/dark and decoded checkerboard. Clean transparency remains around and between the person/weight, with no distracting matte, colored fringe or clipped extremity.

checks.name: small-usage-and-containment
checks.observation: Viewed source/runtime helper panels at 256x144 and 320x180 plus both-size all-eight current-container composites. Squat depth, chest grip, both knees and complete planted shoes remain recognizable. All figure and weight are contained; fine finger detail is clearer enlarged.

checks.name: interface-remnants
checks.observation: No text, weight numbers, labels, arrows, branding, gym/scenery, app controls, phone frame or watermark observed.

limitations: Visible alpha>=128 bbox [594,30,1084,901] on 1672x941 leaves approximately 5.7dp above and 7.7dp below at 180dp height. Vertical margins are modest rather than generous; full head and shoes are contained.
